captured_from: The responses of a real froglet-node (role dual, version 0.4.6-beta.4) that had published examples/wasm-services adder as the service demo.adder, for one free deal with input {"a": 6, "b": 7}. Shared by the node's shape test and the docs-site playground tests, so what the playground says about the wire is what a node sends.
published_module_provenance: Exact reference adder bytes retained from the Rust 1.91.0 wasm32-unknown-unknown macOS build, after their SHA-256 matched the captured service and signed receipt. Rebuilds can embed different Rust sysroot paths; replay these retained bytes rather than assuming a fresh build has the same identity.
